# halos_capabilities (Data Source)

Optional server features and the caller's permissions and scoped role bindings (GET /api/v1/capabilities).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "halos_capabilities" "this" {}

output "kill_switch_configured" {
  value = data.halos_capabilities.this.kill_switch
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `bindings` (Attributes List) The caller's role bindings; an empty rings and units means global. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--bindings))
- `id` (String) Always `capabilities`.
- `kill_switch` (Boolean) Whether the server has a kill-switch signing key configured.
- `permissions` (List of String) Permissions the roles grant.
- `roles` (List of String) Role names granted to the caller.

<a id="nestedatt--bindings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `bindings`

Read-Only:

- `rings` (List of String) Rings the binding is limited to.
- `role` (String) Role name.
- `source` (String) Where the binding comes from, for example `identity.roleBindings[0]`.
- `units` (List of String) Units the binding is limited to.
